include(ExternalContent)

################################################################################
# Dependencies
#
# Built in isolation through ExternalContent, so that neither their options nor
# their targets leak into this project. Only Release builds are used, as the
# result is linked into programs by clang which uses the release C runtime.
################################################################################
set(_DEPENDENCY_ARGS -G "${CMAKE_GENERATOR}" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release)
if(CMAKE_GENERATOR_PLATFORM)
	list(APPEND _DEPENDENCY_ARGS -A "${CMAKE_GENERATOR_PLATFORM}")
endif()
if(CMAKE_GENERATOR_TOOLSET)
	list(APPEND _DEPENDENCY_ARGS -T "${CMAKE_GENERATOR_TOOLSET}")
endif()
if(CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE)
	list(APPEND _DEPENDENCY_ARGS "-DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=${CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE}")
endif()
if(NOT CMAKE_GENERATOR MATCHES "Visual Studio")
	list(APPEND _DEPENDENCY_ARGS "-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=${CMAKE_C_COMPILER}" "-DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER}")
endif()

# Vulkan headers. The Vulkan loader itself is never linked: SDL loads it at runtime.
ExternalContent(
	NAME VulkanHeaders
	GIT_URL "https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers"
	GIT_REF "vulkan-sdk-1.4.363.0"
	GIT_CLONE_OPTIONS --depth 1
	CONFIGURE_ARGS ${_DEPENDENCY_ARGS} -DBUILD_TESTS=OFF
	BUILD_ARGS --config Release
	INSTALL_ARGS --config Release
)

# SDL3, statically linked so that the programs we produce are a single file.
ExternalContent(
	NAME SDL3
	GIT_URL "https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL"
	GIT_REF "release-3.4.18"
	GIT_CLONE_OPTIONS --depth 1
	CONFIGURE_ARGS ${_DEPENDENCY_ARGS}
		-DSDL_STATIC=ON -DSDL_SHARED=OFF -DSDL_TESTS=OFF -DSDL_EXAMPLES=OFF -DSDL_INSTALL_DOCS=OFF
	BUILD_ARGS --config Release --parallel
	INSTALL_ARGS --config Release
)

if(WIN32)
	set(_SDL3_LIBRARY "${SDL3_INSTALL_PATH}/lib/SDL3-static.lib")
else()
	set(_SDL3_LIBRARY "${SDL3_INSTALL_PATH}/lib/libSDL3.a")
endif()
if(NOT EXISTS "${_SDL3_LIBRARY}")
	message(FATAL_ERROR "SDL3 was not built: '${_SDL3_LIBRARY}' is missing.")
endif()

# Libraries that programs have to link to, which the compiler copies next to itself.
set(BLITZRT_LIBRARIES "${_SDL3_LIBRARY}" PARENT_SCOPE)

################################################################################
# Runtime Library
#
# Linked into every program that the compiler produces.
################################################################################
add_library(blitzrt STATIC)
init_project(blitzrt)

target_sources(blitzrt PRIVATE
	"source/runtime.c"
	"source/graphics.cpp"
	"source/font8x8.inc"
	"source/shaders.inc"
)
target_include_directories(blitzrt PRIVATE
	"${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/source"
)
target_include_directories(blitzrt SYSTEM PRIVATE
	"${SDL3_INSTALL_PATH}/include"
	"${VulkanHeaders_INSTALL_PATH}/include"
)
if(MSVC)
	# No C++ runtime dependencies: the library is linked by clang into programs.
	target_compile_options(blitzrt PRIVATE /GR- /EHs-c- /Zc:preprocessor)
	target_compile_definitions(blitzrt PRIVATE _HAS_EXCEPTIONS=0)
	# Programs are linked by clang, which uses the dynamic release C runtime.
	target_compile_options(blitzrt PRIVATE /MD)
endif()

get_target_property(_SOURCES blitzrt SOURCES)
source_group(TREE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} FILES ${_SOURCES})
